name: 闪尾狐
description: 复用已验收闪尾狐，橙红毛色与蓬松火焰形尾巴。
design: 橙红毛色、蓬松火焰形尾巴；复用已验收图片。

name: 芽芽龙
description: 复用已验收芽芽龙，叶冠与花朵辨识草属性。
design: 叶片大耳与花朵尾端；复用已验收图片。

name: 岩背龟
description: 复用已验收岩背龟，厚重岩甲与短肢。
design: 岩石甲壳与短粗四肢；复用已验收图片。

name: 绒团兔
description: Small compact cream rabbit, round pear body, short folded ears, a huge fluffy cotton tail, soft peach belly. Tiny companion, no armor.
design: 奶油白垂耳、圆滚身体与巨大棉球尾，温和小伙伴。

name: 潮泡獭
description: Small aqua otter pup, round cream muzzle, translucent blue bubble collar, broad paddle tail and tiny webbed feet, playful and compact.
design: 浅蓝毛色、泡泡项圈与桨状尾巴，一眼识别水属性。

name: 蓄电貂
description: Small slim golden marten with teal capacitor-like ear tufts, black zigzag back stripe and a short curled cable-like tail ending in two golden prongs. No red cheek circles.
design: 金黄毛色、青色耳尖、闪电纹与卷尾，轻快机灵。

name: 霜团海豹
description: Small plump pale-blue seal pup, white snowball belly, tiny icy flipper fins, three clear ice crystals like a little crown, very round cute body.
design: 圆润海豹、晶冰头冠与冰晶鳍足，冷色清透。

name: 拳铠猿
description: Large muscular but cute upright copper-red gorilla, broad shoulders, heavy stone-like ivory forearm gauntlets organically grown, deep navy chest and red crest, thick limbs, clear elite silhouette. No weapon.
design: 宽肩厚臂、岩质拳铠与赤红鬃毛，成熟强壮的精英。

name: 毒泡蜗
description: Small violet sea slug with lime-green translucent bubble shell, two short curled feelers, stubby body, cute sleepy eyes, three small poison-green spots.
design: 紫色软体与荧绿泡泡蜗壳，毒属性色彩鲜明。

name: 铲角鼹
description: Small sandy tan mole pup with rounded shovel-shaped nose horn, broad dark-brown digging paws, terracotta back plates, compact squat body.
design: 沙棕短身、铲形鼻端、大挖掘爪与赤陶背甲。

name: 云翎雀
description: Small sky-blue songbird with fluffy white cloud wing tips and a curled breeze-shaped crest, tiny feet, pale gold beak, simple round body.
design: 浅蓝圆鸟、云朵翅尖与卷风头羽，轻盈可爱。

name: 星环鸮
description: Large regal violet owl mage creature, broad wing mantle, two floating golden orbital rings behind shoulders, lilac chest diamond, bright turquoise eyes, imposing wide silhouette, visible short talons. Not humanoid.
design: 深紫宽翼羽披风、金色星环与胸前晶石，神秘精英。

name: 芽角甲虫
description: Small emerald beetle with two broad rounded elytra, ivory forked sprout-shaped horn, six short friendly legs, amber eyes, peach underside, round compact beetle.
design: 圆润绿甲、芽形分叉大角与六足，昆虫轮廓清晰。

name: 灯芯幽灵
description: Small lavender ghost resembling a soft floating lantern, cream glowing face, two droopy little wispy arms, short curled ghost tail instead of feet, tiny blue flame tuft. Cute rather than scary.
design: 幽紫灯笼软体、蓝焰头顶与卷曲尾，友善小幽灵。

name: 霆冠龙
description: Huge majestic quadrupedal indigo dragon, broad chest and powerful legs, enormous swept-back ivory crown horns, large layered turquoise bat wings, glowing gold chest diamond, thick armored tail. Epic king silhouette unmistakably a BOSS, not a baby, still appealing collectible monster. Entire wings contained.
design: 巨大角冠、宽翼、厚尾与金色胸甲；威严龙属性 BOSS。

name: 暮影猞猁
description: Small charcoal-purple lynx kitten, huge pointed ears with crescent tufts, dark plum fluffy tail, cream eye mask and tiny golden eyes, mischievous appealing short-legged body.
design: 暗紫猞猁、长耳簇与蓬松卷尾，狡黠而讨喜。

name: 铁垒犀
description: Huge powerful quadrupedal steel rhinoceros fortress creature, oversized silver shoulder plates and broad navy chest, large smooth bronze nose horn, stepped shield-like back armor, thick solid legs with bronze hooves, turquoise glowing seams. Epic armored BOSS silhouette, no guns or buildings.
design: 重叠钢铁装甲、巨大金属鼻角和粗壮四足；钢属性 BOSS。

name: 铃芽鹿
description: Small pastel pink fawn with cream face and tiny golden bell-shaped antlers, mint bow-shaped ear fur, one star-shaped tail tuft, delicate short legs and round baby body.
design: 粉色幼鹿、铃兰花角、薄荷耳朵与星形尾，梦幻妖精。
